info.name: Hanzi Match API (authenticated)
info.description: All 5 Hanzi Match tables with real logins. Set the collection variable publishable_key (your sb_publishable_... key), then Run the collection in order. Folder 0 signs up (or reuses) two test accounts and saves their access tokens; every table request sends user A's token, and folder 6 uses user B's token to prove RLS isolation. Needs 'Confirm email' OFF in Supabase (Authentication > Sign In / Providers > Email). Cleans up its rows at the end; the two test accounts stay in Authentication > Users.

request.description: Creates test user A. `data.name` goes into the auth metadata; the on_auth_user_created trigger copies it into public.users. 422 means the account exists from an earlier run, which is fine.
Creates test user B. `data.name` goes into the auth metadata; the on_auth_user_created trigger copies it into public.users. 422 means the account exists from an earlier run, which is fine.
